inputs.multi_shot.prompt: The person puts one hand on the hip and turns the shoulders toward the camera with a small smile, the outfit stays exactly the same. Same background, same light and same framing as the first frame; the person stays in place. Locked-off steady camera, cool, confident attitude, one continuous shot, no cuts, face and outfit unchanged.
